title: Only skip draft preparation for the Payables Agent's own e-documents with agent-driven line matching
summary: Draft preparation skip now applies only to the Payables Agent's own e-documents when agent-driven line matching is enabled, restoring normal preparation for other e-document services.
key_points: Narrowed draft preparation skip condition to check both experiment enablement and e-document service being the agent's AGENT service
Prevents vendor, purchase order, line matching and VAT posting group information loss for PEPPOL and other service e-documents
Maintains agent's internal draft preparation workflow without affecting other providers
Experiment behavior preserved; no changes when feature experiment is disabled
Service code duplicated as label to avoid cross-app dependency
